title: Dial M For Murder tour - review
transcript: I'm Paul 7 Lewis this is Richmond theatre and I'm here to see the opening of the tour of dial M for murder the touring production of dial M for murder by Frederick not directed by Anthony banks which I saw at Richmond theatres to call dial M for murder a thriller may be an exaggeration it doesn't exactly have you on the edge of your seat certainly not jumping out of it but you will be wondering whether the criminal will be caught and if so how and along the way you'll enjoy fun intrigue and a little bit of excitement if you know the Alfred Hitchcock film which was based on this play you'll know it has a clever plot with a few excellent twists Tony an impecunious tennis player plans to murder his rich wife because she's fallen in love with someone else and he doesn't want to lose his cash cow he recruits an old acquaintance with a need for money and a leaning towards crime it could be the perfect murder unless he makes a mistake the setup is slow but once it gets going especially when events cause Tony to improvise it becomes quite gripping like watching a high-level tennis match fortunately the production is blessed with two fine actors in the lead roles Tom Chambers as Tony is wonderfully Lucien with an amusing habit of striking tennis playing poses on the other side of the net Christopher Harper's Police Inspector is a worthy opponent he exudes Authority intelligence and determination I give dial M for murder three stars well that's the 1-minute review keep listening for more on dial M for murder the play was written in 1951 and the clip dialogue and repressed emotions are typical at the time in fact I'm not sure why director Anthony banks has transferred the action to the more unbuttoned 60s when that birthday decade makes an affair and the planning of another more shocking on the plus side David Wood heads angular set with much early sixties detail gives a good sense of both the period and those striking camera angles that were famously used by Alfred Hitchcock by the way there's an inadvertent spoiler in the programs cast lists I advise not looking at that until we interval all in all if you fancy a night out you could do a lot worse than this diverting play I give dial M for murder three stars if you've enjoyed this review and found it useful please subscribe to my youtube channel one-minute theater views and for a longer written review please visit my website 1-minute theater reviews code at UK you
